method: Direct fresh original-detail inspection of source/endpoint atlas plus all six4x nearest-neighbor paired comparison sheets rendered only from frozen PNGs. limitations: Two seeds and one infant source cannot establish arbitrary-drawing robustness.
Source edits can reorganize several regions while inherited genes remain identical; this is not proof of strictly local edit influence.
Tail/eye effects are visibly subtle; numerical differences alone would not make them dramatic.
Spontaneous head/body separation in body-bend seed02day120 is a real coherence failure. Source ratios must distinguish already-authored gaps from unintended later gaps.
No human review or expanded audit acceptance follows.
